account.title: Lollipop account
account.description: Use the sign-in form above for automatic camera discovery. It saves your email here and stores the session privately on the Homebridge host.

password.title: Password (headless setup only)
password.description: Optional for configuration without the sign-in form. This value is stored in config.json. Interactive sign-in above avoids storing the password and supports email verification codes.

sessionToken.title: Session token (headless setup only)
sessionToken.description: Optional existing account session for configuration without the sign-in form. This value is stored in config.json. Leave empty when using interactive sign-in.

cameraDefaults.title: Account camera preferences
cameraDefaults.description: Apply these preferences to automatically discovered account cameras. Camera overrides below can change individual cameras.

audio.title: Enable camera audio
audio.description: Listen to the camera microphone. Disable to troubleshoot a stream with unsupported or missing audio.

enableSoundMachine.title: Enable sound-machine switch
enableSoundMachine.description: Play or pause each camera’s sound machine from a HomeKit switch.

unbridge.title: Configure camera as an unbridged accessory
unbridge.description: This is recommended if you aren't running the plugin as a child bridge and you don't have HKSV enabled.

contactSensors.title: Configure the sensors as Contact Sensors rather than Motion Sensors.

movementSensitivity.title: Movement Sensitivity Level
movementSensitivity.description: Select the level of movement sensitivity to trigger the movement sensor attached to the HomeKit camera.

enableCryingDetectionSensor.title: Expose a sensor for crying detection notifications.
enableCryingDetectionSensor.description: Crying Detection must be configured in the Lollipop app for this to trigger.

enableCrossingDetectionSensor.title: Expose a sensor for barrier crossing detection notifications
enableCrossingDetectionSensor.description: Crossing Detection must be configured in the Lollipop app for this to trigger.

enableNoiseSensor.title: Expose a sensor for unacceptable noise detection notifications.
enableNoiseSensor.description: Noise must be configured in the Lollipop app for this to trigger.

name.title: Name
name.description: HomeKit name. In account mode, an existing matching name can also select the camera to override.

accountCameraName.title: Camera name in the Lollipop app
accountCameraName.description: Optional selector when overriding an account camera. Enter its current name in the Lollipop app, then choose the HomeKit name above. Omit for automatic setup.

enabled.title: Enable this camera
enabled.description: Turn off to hide this selected account camera from Homebridge.

cameraId.title: Camera ID (pairing ID)
cameraId.description: Optional advanced selector for an account camera. For manual setup, combine the original camera/pairing ID with its IP to enable authenticated video without controls. Use the original ID, not the hardware serial or hashed stream path.

rtspUsername.title: RTSP username
rtspUsername.description: Used with Camera ID to calculate the stream password. Ignored when a complete authenticated RTSP URL is supplied.

rtspUrl.title: Authenticated RTSP URL
rtspUrl.description: Optional complete authenticated video URL. Account mode still connects controls automatically. Manual RTSP-only setup does not include sensors or sound controls.

ip.title: Camera IP or hostname
ip.description: Manual setup only: address or hostname without a port or path. Account cameras use the address reported by Lollipop automatically. Optional with a complete RTSP URL.

audio.title: Enable camera audio
audio.description: Listen to the camera microphone. Disable to troubleshoot a stream with unsupported or missing audio.

unbridge.title: Configure camera as an unbridged accessory
unbridge.description: This is recommended if you aren't running the plugin as a child bridge and you don't have HKSV enabled.

hksv.title: Enable HomeKit Secure Video Recording
hksv.description: Legacy experimental recording option. HomeKit Secure Video remains unavailable in account setup and manual authenticated video modes.

enableSoundMachine.title: Enable sound-machine switch
enableSoundMachine.description: Play or pause the built-in sound machine from HomeKit. Enabled by default for account cameras. Requires MQTT; unavailable in manual RTSP-only setup.

contactSensors.title: Configure the sensors as Contact Sensors rather than Motion Sensors.

movementSensitivity.title: Movement Sensitivity Level
movementSensitivity.description: Select the level of movement sensitivity to trigger the movement sensor attached to the HomeKit camera.

enableCryingDetectionSensor.title: Expose a sensor for crying detection notifications.
enableCryingDetectionSensor.description: Crying Detection must be configured in the Lollipop app for this to trigger.

enableCrossingDetectionSensor.title: Expose a sensor for barrier crossing detection notifications
enableCrossingDetectionSensor.description: Crossing Detection must be configured in the Lollipop app for this to trigger.

enableNoiseSensor.title: Expose a sensor for unacceptable noise detection notifications.
enableNoiseSensor.description: Noise must be configured in the Lollipop app for this to trigger.

lollipops.title: Camera overrides or manual cameras
lollipops.description: With account sign-in, use optional overrides to rename or hide a camera. Cameras are discovered automatically. Without an account, enter manual connection details here.

debug.title: Enable debug logging
debug.description: Record detailed account setup, camera discovery, MQTT, switch, and video diagnostics in the Homebridge and Homebridge UI logs. Restart the Lollipop child bridge or Homebridge after changing this setting. The sign-in form above applies it immediately to setup requests. Turn off after testing.
